tom: heads up — preflight on `summarizer-pro` failed the gating checks. quality delta: ROUGE-L -3.5%, factuality alerts 7/60. deploybot recommends hold. change window closes in ~40m. need quick product + ops call.

deploybot: preflight result -> FAILED
  - suite: summarizer-pro-prompts
  - diffs: rouge-l -3.5%, factuality -7% relative, human-flag 7/60
  - suggested actions: revert to v2.9.4, or phased split (10-25%), or bisect v3.0.0
  - details: https://releases.redwood.ai/preflight/4395555555

riley: any signal whether this is long-context only?

tom: most failures are multi-bullet summaries and cross-doc merges. looks like condensation changed heuristics.

morgan: ops can do a region pin quickly. proposal: EU -> pin v2.9.4; US -> 20% traffic to v3.0.0 until triage. that minimizes exposure.

anya: product preference is to revert globally if it's causing factuality drops on billable pipelines. partials are ok if they materially reduce customer impact. i'm leaning rollback.

chris: from infra: pin is ~10m, smoke-run another ~8m. no session loss. ops-bot: confirm policy for change-window rollbacks?

ops-bot: reminder: rollback during change window requires product sign-off within 30m. automated escalation if no decision.

anya: confirm rollback. please pin summarizer-pro -> v2.9.4 and draft release note.

tom: /deploybot pin summarizer-pro v2.9.4 --reason "preflight factuality regression"

deploybot: ack. job queued id=rb-20240323-4395555555 status=running logs: https://releases.redwood.ai/jobs/rb-20240323-4395555555/logs

riley: capturing the 7 failing samples into eval-bisect/4395555555. starting triage once pin completes.

morgan: pin job complete. status=SUCCESS. pinned summarizer-pro -> v2.9.4. smoke-run in progress.

chris: smoke-run passed top_200 no latency regressions.

anya: good. filing follow-up ticket for bisect + tokenizer/anchoring checks: https://tickets.redwood.ai/TKT-11077

tom: closing thread. thanks all :white_check_mark:
